chapter: Harry James, Bellson and the return to Duke
title: Harry James phoned Rose first
summary: James called Rose to find Juan before forming his band; she warned him not to expect Juan for nothing and tipped Juan off.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Harry called me about Juan because he called me, you know, first, and he said, "Rose, I'm getting ready to get my band together and I'd like for Juan to be in it." And he said, "Where can I find Juan?" So I told him, and he said, "How much salary an hour do you think he'd want?" and I said, "I don't have the slightest idea, but don't think you can get him for nothing, because he doesn't don't work for nothing."

So he asked me for the telephone number, and I called Juan immediately and told him that Harry was going to call, and then Harry called him. Probably Harry called him while I was on the phone with him, you know, and the line was busy, and then Harry called him and told him. But I'd already tipped Juan off.
But he was a nice guy.
